decision: Prioritize architectural massing before visual polish. Five practical mid-budget concepts plus five optional. Preserve V69 and all V70–V74 lab assets. Do not use model color variations as distinct architecture.
areaCaveat: Source areas use different conventions. Target areas are design goals, not verified floor areas.

briefs.title: Скандинавский фронтон
briefs.architecture: One main gable with tall living-room end glazing and recessed timber entrance. Not a box plus freestanding canopy.
briefs.costGuard: Standard bedroom windows; glazing restricted to living room; no continuous full-height facade.
briefs.status: design brief only; original geometry not yet created

briefs.title: Кирпичный Craftsman
briefs.architecture: Two readable volumes, main gable plus offset entry gable, low masonry piers and timber canopy; staggered bedroom and living window sizes.
briefs.costGuard: Limit valleys, conventional roof spans, local brick or clinker accents.
briefs.status: design brief only; original geometry not yet created

briefs.title: Садовое бунгало
briefs.architecture: L-shaped living and sleeping volumes enclose private shaded terrace; horizontally framed entry niche.
briefs.costGuard: No obligatory garage, compact wet core, pitched or flat roof variants separately evaluated.
briefs.status: design brief only; original geometry not yet created

briefs.title: Европейский дом с мансардой
briefs.architecture: Deep pitched silhouette; one measured dormer or garden gable, bay opening to terrace, varied facade depth.
briefs.costGuard: Avoid two expensive dormers by default; attic usable area and stair geometry calculated separately.
briefs.status: design brief only; original geometry not yet created

briefs.title: Современный семейный коттедж
briefs.architecture: Compact two storeys with stepped entrance and one-storey garden wing; clear hierarchy of volumes; no generic symmetrical cube.
briefs.costGuard: Simplify garage to optional separate wing; standard window modules and avoid excessive roof intersections.
briefs.status: design brief only; original geometry not yet created

briefs.title: Лесной дом
briefs.architecture: Two low volumes around sheltered entry terrace; natural materials, long framed views.
briefs.costGuard: Adapt to ordinary level site; not direct replication of award-winning design.
briefs.status: design brief only; original geometry not yet created

briefs.title: Американский farmhouse
briefs.architecture: Broad porch and separate cross gable; grouped windows with simple vertical siding and brick base.
briefs.costGuard: Avoid decorative dormers that do not serve rooms.
briefs.status: design brief only; original geometry not yet created

briefs.title: Южный дом с патио
briefs.architecture: Private courtyard or sheltered outdoor dining, strong indoor-outdoor connection, shading.
briefs.costGuard: Climate-adapted glazing, roof and drainage; no assumption Brazilian design suits Russian climate.
briefs.status: design brief only; original geometry not yet created

briefs.title: Городской дом с мансардой
briefs.architecture: Narrow footprint, restrained upper gable, stepped rear terrace, differentiated street and garden fronts.
briefs.costGuard: Third level subject to stair, height, local constraints; reserve rather than default.
briefs.status: design brief only; original geometry not yet created

briefs.title: Современный дом с защищённым входом
briefs.architecture: Two offset rectangular volumes, recessed entry, contrast of wood and plaster, daylight to stair.
briefs.costGuard: Flat-roof drainage and waterproofing must be costed; no projecting unsupported cantilevers.
briefs.status: design brief only; original geometry not yet created
